name: web-misty-meadow-thank-you-banner
title: Thank-you banner with thin white caps over a misty flower meadow
whatItIs: A wide image of soft-focus wildflowers and moss lit by hazy light with a grey sky. 'THANK YOU FOR WATCHING!' is set in thin white capitals with a short contact line beneath.
whatItMeans: Peaceful and elegant; natural mist gives a sense of exhale at the end.
techniques: Use a shallow-depth nature photo as a full-bleed closing image.
Set light-weight caps in white with a small grey subline.
Leave the sky as open space for text.
Round the frame's corners to match the deck.
bestFor: Closing slides of wellness or botanical projects

vocabulary.definition: Photography with a sharply blurred background.
Placing text over the empty sky area of a photo.
An image and short message that ends a presentation.
Uppercase text in a light weight.
